description: Reads a site's public crossdomain.xml (Adobe Flash) and clientaccesspolicy.xml (Silverlight) if they exist, lists the origins they allow, and flags wildcard grants ('*'). Old policies are rarely needed now, so a wildcard here mostly means leftovers; absence is the normal case. Related tools on this server, for a different need: security_mx_server_test when you need for a mail domain: lists up to 3 MX hosts with their IPv4; security_smb_exposure_test when you need to check Shodan's passive scan records for TCP port 445. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_crossdomain_xml_test
title: Reads a site's public crossdomain.xml
